note: Versioned audit config for python -m scripts.verify_fund_nav_identity_v2 (implements nav-identity-audit-v3); the operator pins the SHA-256 of THIS repository file, so a re-pin is a reviewed change, never a temporary production edit. configs/nav_identity_audit_v2.json is kept only as the historical, non-publishable record of the blocked v2 audit. Pinned to Light main aeb5933754f46af997198a0ab82c14e108a4553a (merge of PR #166; origin/main re-read 2026-09-25 still at this commit). Before a strict audit OPS must confirm, live, that the deployed Light revision, the builder request/policy and the Stage-1 quotas are still these; otherwise re-pin light_revision, cohort_query/parameters and stage1_quotas in a reviewed change. structural_daily_ceiling bounds P = structural daily pre-claims/pre-SEC population; it is a ceiling, never a target, never auto-raised, and the retired key active_ceiling is rejected. structural_baseline is the drift baseline B (v1 structural daily without ISIN); a non-zero delta must be explained and acknowledged via accepted_structural_delta, which never raises the ceiling. margin_fraction is a contract constant (exactly "1/10"). expected_previous_inactive pins the PUBLISHED v1 (the previous policy for continuity; a v2 artifact is never a previous policy).

sec.rationale: SEC corroboration (identity v3) uses public.sec_company_tickers_mf only, the external class/series/ticker crosswalk; updated_at is refreshed on every upsert (fetched_at is not). Exactly 7 days, not tunable: a row is fresh when 0 <= instant - updated_at <= 7 days (7 days + 1 microsecond is stale). The generator judges every candidate that passes every internal gate at its decision instant tau (first failure after activity: declared_class_invalid > poisoned_mapping > contradiction > ambiguous > incomplete > stale > missing); the auditor recomputes it independently at generated_at and, for A8, re-judges every ACTIVE (MMF included) at the capture instant. gap_ceiling (incomplete+stale+missing) and conflict_ceiling (declared_class_invalid+poisoned_mapping+contradiction+ambiguous) are reviewed, fixed FUND counts (23 and 0), never source-row counts, never auto-raised; the config must carry exactly these integers. The source is upsert-only: a fresh timestamp does not prove a complete refresh or the withdrawal of absent classes; a SEC exclusion is current-only (re-evaluated at the next generation), not a legal statement of closure.

builder.quota_provenance: observed Stage-1 slots alternatives=6 equity=8 fixed_income=14 thematic=2; the caller at aeb59337 backend/app/services/portfolio_builder.py:3590-3594 uses _regime_selection_slots(min_slots=1), not the default 2. Re-pin from the real request before use.
builder.cohort_query_provenance: mirrors backend/app/optimizer/data.py select_universe_funds catalog quality gates at aeb59337 (unchanged from a3e21f40: MIN_UNIVERSE_AUM_USD=200000000, strategy_label <> 'Unclassified', LEFT JOIN fund_risk_latest_mv nav_quality_ok NULL/TRUE, fund_nav_coverage_mv n_obs >= MIN_COMMON_OBS=400 and first_nav <= today - MIN_UNIVERSE_HISTORY_DAYS=1095, full-history window). A7 measures pre-readiness potential: the aeb59337 current-readiness join (fund_nav_readiness_current_v1 READY) is deliberately NOT applied. Request-specific funds_catalog filters are NOT included and must be added when the pinned request uses them. The verifier wraps this SELECT server-side with an outer LIMIT 100001 and reads it through a server-side cursor.
builder.cohort_query: SELECT f.instrument_id, f.strategy_label FROM public.funds_profile_mv f LEFT JOIN public.fund_risk_latest_mv r ON r.instrument_id = f.instrument_id JOIN public.fund_nav_coverage_mv c ON c.instrument_id = f.instrument_id WHERE f.aum_usd IS NOT NULL AND f.aum_usd >= %(min_aum_usd)s AND f.strategy_label <> 'Unclassified' AND (r.nav_quality_ok IS NULL OR r.nav_quality_ok IS TRUE) AND c.n_obs >= %(min_obs)s AND c.first_nav <= current_date - %(history_days)s::int ORDER BY f.instrument_id LIMIT 100001
